title: Yeasty Crisp Irish Lettuce Salad
description: A romantic Irish dish featuring little gem lettuce, blanched to perfection and topped with a yeasty crust.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the butter and flour to make a roux, cooking for 2 minutes over medium heat.
Gradually add 1 cup of milk to the saucepan, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, until thickened.
Set the sauce aside to cool slightly.
In a large skillet, blanch the little gem lettuce leaves in boiling water for 30 seconds, then plunge into a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process.
Drain the lettuce leaves and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the grated cheddar cheese, fresh thyme, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Divide the blanched lettuce leaves among 4 plates, then top each plate with the cooled sauce and sprinkle with the cheese mixture.
Drizzle the red wine vinegar over the top of each plate, to taste.
